$comment: Schema for a LearningAssistant question bank file. Each file holds all questions for one topic. Questions are linked to concepts in the matching plans/ file via concept_id.

topic_slug.description: Must match the topic_slug in the corresponding plans/ file.

question_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this question. Suggested format: <topic_slug>-Q<zero-padded-number>.

concept_id.description: Links this question to a concept in the learning plan. Must match a concept_id in the corresponding plans/ file.

question_type.description: The format of the question. Copilot evaluates free_text answers heuristically.

question_text.description: The full text of the question as it will be presented to the user.

options.description: Required when question_type is 'multiple_choice'. Each item is one answer option.

text.description: The full text of this option.

correct_answer.description: For multiple_choice: the key of the correct option (e.g. 'B'). For true_false: 'true' or 'false'. For free_text: the model/reference answer.

explanation.description: Shown to the user after they answer. Explains why the correct answer is correct and, where relevant, why common wrong answers are wrong.

difficulty.description: Difficulty rating from 1 (introductory) to 5 (expert). Used by the adaptive scheduler.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this question was created.
